approval_basis: Independent review of frozen commit be3fc64e483b917796d411cdfadf19b18fc7d284 for F-2026-09-10-013, retained in /Users/haiyan/.local/share/open-cake-ir/reviews/2026-09-10-m4-be3fc64-01a08ba9.json. Effective gpt-6-astra/high and reviewer session 01a08ba9-096a-7431-805d-bc4c408a5af0 were verified from the rollout session_meta and turn_context, distinct from author 01a08b72-c9cb-78e3-a088-bf1358269279; the inherited CODEX_SESSION_ID was not used as reviewer identity. Reviewed AGENTS.md, ADRs 0052/0060, the exact implementation/documentation/test diff, target definition, complete Gate and expectation migration. The existing release gate builder independently reproduced the retained schema-2 awaiting_review Gate, 124/124 cases matched, at this frozen release boundary. P1/P3: no new authoring form or layout abstraction; existing compositional Metal Schedule is retained. P2/P5/P7: exact architecture/device and existing hardware legality remain explicit, while Apple9 rejects CUDA compute capability and borrowed occupancy/peak; independent assessment/profile/ranking probes abstain from uncalibrated M4 performance. P4: the typed target admission and localized preflight remain before lowering. P6: full Corpus Gate plus focused tests and public boundary probes support this Compiler change. P8: Apple's Metal Feature Set Tables, https://developer.apple.com/metal/Metal-Feature-Set-Tables.pdf (May 21 2026, pages 2 and 7), confirm M4-series Apple9, 1024 threads, 32 KiB threadgroup storage and 31 buffer arguments. I read the retained inspect-report.json and build-report.json on haiyan-mini@haiyan-Mac-mini.local at /Users/haiyan-mini/.local/share/open-cake-ir/m4-validation/run.VOJD7M: exact Apple M4/family9, compute-stage timestamps, strict archive pipeline width 32, maximum threads 1024 and zero dispatches. The inherited MSL arithmetic spelling is unchanged; the Apple MSL PDF could not be retrieved by the web tool during this review. Independently exercised Compiler.load/assess/lower/profile/rank for elementwise, row_sum, row_max and rmsnorm at (1,1), (3,37), (2,65): all 12 preserve the M4 target and abstain from calibration; same-family Apple M3 and M4 Pro plus M2 are refused by METAL_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED, family10 by TARGET_UNSUPPORTED, and CUDA/occupancy/peak target additions by their intended TargetParseError rules. I approve the narrowly scoped corpus migration: the existing unsupported-future-target fixture moves only family9 to family10 because family9 is now supported, and only its expected schedule identity changes; accepted=false, lowering=false, TARGET_UNSUPPORTED and null source remain fixed, with all other corpus expectations unchanged. Independent pytest of test_metal, test_metal_runtime, test_task_launch and test_compiler_revision_architecture yielded 75 passed, one existing fixture skip, 234 subtests passed, and four failures across two released-admission tests. Inspection establishes those fixtures read the prior top-level release lock against the newly prepared Gate and fail with released Corpus Gate report bytes differ; they do not exercise a failing M4 behavior. No lock, environment or fixture was repaired or normalized, and this is not an all-tests-pass claim. Additional independent test_metal_executor and test_metal_benchmark checks passed 27 tests and 35 subtests. Author-reported additional evidence was 89 focused unittest tests with one skip, Swift typechecks of all three helpers, and 29/29 M4 starter task lowerings; these are distinguished from my own execution. No blocking defect found in this exact target extension. Approval covers Compiler construction only: it is not M4 GPU numerical correctness, end-to-end framework acceptance, performance qualification, calibration, or permission to reuse another host's Executor. The capability Finding remains open until successor campaign verification. No implementation, expectation, release lock or source file was modified by this reviewer.
